title: Bounded VT scheduling preserves control latency

cases.summary: 16 PTYs, eight clients, 16 requests in flight and 1 MiB/s aggregate output: every input.send admission and every committed control event is delivered within 100 ms (admission_max_ms <= 100, event_max_ms <= 100), with sample counts and zero lost events reported; a 50-terminal/400-viewer run stays within 1 GiB total RSS and the 4 GiB data budget while stalled viewers are told how many events they lost.

input.raw with data_b64 fixture:input-queue-cap-plus-one (16 MiB + 1 byte) returns input_overflow before admission (no receipt, zero bytes held) while the program never reads stdin; a cancel of a queued entry is still served within 100 ms and reports withdrawn; an acknowledgement beyond the bytes sent grants no credit.
